full_budget_rule: Execute five times as an identical-input control; require matching saved prediction, metric and calibrator hashes; count once per source case in aggregates
historical_partial_budget_rule: Original budget_v1 draw is a historical reference, excluded from the new five-draw summaries
scope: Exploratory subset and calibration-selection stability under the unchanged fixed OOF assignment procedure; no fresh-data confirmation, method tuning or model replacement
